notes.coldStart: Single sample each. Cold = first call after an explicit keep_alive:0 unload.

enrich.summary.short.reason: below MIN_SUMMARY_WORDS (25) - the app skips this path

ghostText.suggestion.budgetNote: Fires while the user types. Above a few hundred ms the suggestion arrives after the thought and is worse than absent.

ollamaList.execSyncBlock.note: Main process is fully unresponsive for this duration (warm daemon).

whisper.spawnAndModelLoad.note: Near-empty clip: approximates the fixed per-transcription overhead.

startup.profile: copy of the real profile: mind-sage.db, Local Storage
startup.note: Measured against the packaged build and a copy of the real user profile. The first run of a session is the closest to cold; later runs benefit from the OS file cache. A launch after a reboot would be colder than anything measured here.

render.dashboardSettle.note: Time until rendered text stops changing, minus a 200ms stability window.

memory.overSession.note: Three passes over five routes. Growth here is not proof of a leak - caches warm too.

bundle.note: Bytes attributed by decoding sourcemap mappings; unattributed bytes are bundler scaffolding.
